notes.title: We are in Simfest: Hobby Edition - Birding Simulator
notes.notes:
It's time to announce that we will take part in the Simfest: Hobby Edition - a celebration that attempts to simulate a hobby! And everybody knows that Birding is a great initiative to spend free time. We'll conduct live streams during the Simfest, to which we warmly invite you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1402650/Birding_Simulator/

notes.title: Gas Station Simulator launching tomorrow
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Our friends over at DRAGO entertainment have been working on a new game that is being released tomorrow, September 15th at 7pm CEST. 
As we are all part of one big developer family, we would like to spread this exciting news for a really deserving and fun game. 

If you ever wanted to restore and run an old gas station on Route 66, that is your chance. 
Visit their Steam page below for more information: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149620/Gas_Station_Simulator/

notes.title: New game announcement
notes.notes:
We are glad to announce to you our new game - Hospital Renovator!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39765413/a62922a8e3c428730d48d0d6baa8856c2c099ba6.png[/img]

Renovate an old and devastated hospital and change it to a world class one! Clean all spaces, fix damaged walls and floors, decide where will be which ward, and add medical equipment. Remember about functionality of every place and necessary high hygienic standards. Create safe, friendly and modern place to save people’s lives!

Add Hospital Renovator to your wishlist on Steam now and follow us for more information!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714980/Hospital_Renovator/

notes.title: INTERASTRA Demo
notes.notes:
The INTERASTRA demo is now available!
From now on, you can download the demo and test the space gameplay.
The game demo offers an exploration of the first level of the Mushroom Planet, crafting, collecting minerals, building rockets, and taking care of basic life parameters.

We kindly ask you to leave your feedback after playing our game. Based on it, we will be able to improve or add more mechanics to the full version of the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1419980/INTERASTRA/
